heard: Most believe no sound can travel across an entire ocean. Yet on August 27, 1883, the volcano Krakatoa erupted. Its 40-meter tsunamis obliterated 165 coastal towns. The atmospheric shock waves circled the entire globe seven times. Spectacular crimson skies triggered false fire alarms in New York. Deep in the Australian outback, people heard the rumble. Across the Indian Ocean on Rodriguez, they heard the blast.
